lines.en: I laugh myself all the way over to the new Chosokabe apartment, but not because this is funny.
Like sure, it’s a bit degrading and a bit comedic being an adult male being called a bitch by a teenage girl, but it’s not like Chika’s wrong about that.
I have been running away from her and I have been off moping and crying and whining about all of my other problems when she’s been readily available to help me with them.
But no, that’s not why I’m laughing. I’m laughing about the irony.
I’m laughing about how she could have found me with twenty other girls back there and that probability dictates I’d likely be fucking one of them when she did.
But instead, she found me with her best friend — a girl I’ve done practically nothing with — and she must now face the music after going out of her way to turn the volume up.
So yeah, I think that’s kind of funny.
I think it’s cute that something so innocent in nature could break her.
But I wonder-
How much more damage can I inflict upon her today?
Which isn’t to say I want to. But I have to.
: Coming!
Some animals, like the opossum, are hesitant to fight. They either flee or they play dead. Or they flee and then play dead once you’ve got them cornered.
But then there are those like dogs and cats — specifically the ones who are afraid of this world — but will fight and claw and bite for a chance to stay here.
And they might not be happy to do it. It might be a huge waste of energy for them. But if that’s what it takes to survive, that’s what they’ll do.
So I walk myself into this corner knowing what awaits me. I’ll make myself look tall or bare my teeth or spread my wings because I want to submit, just not all the way.
And if she swoops in to try and end things, I won’t hesitate to strike back in defense.
Animals work on instinct, you know. And here in Kumon-mi, it’s always mating season.
I can’t afford to let my species go extinct.
But more than that-
The thought of her mating with anyone else just makes me mad.
: H...Hi, Papa.
: Hey, Chinami. Hey, Chika.
: B...Big sis Chika is...a little grumpy today from...getting into a fight with big sis Yumi, so...
: I know. But it’s my fault that fight happened in the first place, so I’m here to try and clear things up.
: It takes two to tango, asshole. Yumi’s not absolved just because you came over here to take the blame for her.
: Even if she didn’t do anything wrong?
: She did plenty wrong, even if your story checks out.
: And if it doesn’t, what then?
: I don’t know, Sensei. You tell me. Gonna trade me in for a brand new toy? You a little bored after using me so many times?
: Should we maybe go outside for-
: Mm!
: ...this.
: Chinami...let go of him.
: Ch...Chinami has a better idea! Why don’t you two talk later and we can all play a game now? Chinami is very bored and thinks her family should be having fun! Right, Papa?
: P...Papa?
: Chinami...let go. Your sister and your father need to have a very important talk right now.
: But...Chinami is scared...
: She doesn’t want to lose a second daddy...
: The first one never deserved us anyway.
: But this one does, doesn’t he?
: Well...I guess we’ll have to see.
: But we can’t do that if you don’t let go of him. Understand?
: Papa...
: You won’t leave us too...will you?...
: I think that’s up to your sister, Chinami.
: Big sis Chika doesn’t want you to leave. I heard her say that. Does this mean the talk is over? You’ll stay together and we can be a family for a little while longer?
: Chinami, let go right now or you’re grounded.
: Chinami is sorry...
: Chinami will leave you alone now...
We wind up on the balcony once Chinami releases her hold on me — which is great, because I was only a second or two away from caving and giving them everything they’d ever want.
At least now I can get back to what I was thinking earlier with the animals and how I...how...
What was it again?...
What did I...how I was...
What was the plan again?...
: If you’re waiting for me to be all sweet and forgiving, we’re going to be out here for a while. That ship sailed the second I saw you fucking Yumi.
: You didn’t see me fucking her, Chika.
: Yeah, well I might as well have with how fucking close the two of you were back there.
: How did you see us anyway?
: With my fucking eyes, idiot. Don’t tell me you were so lost in hers you forgot other people had them.
: No, I meant...I didn’t even know where you were. I kind of figured you just went home after running away or something.
: I’m sure that would have been convenient for you, huh? But I guess it’s not like it mattered in the first place since you just took her back to your room anyway.
: I was looking for you.
: I got tired of passively waiting for you to come find me since it felt like you were never going to.
: So I forced myself to confront the fear that you might be giving those feelings to someone else and...boy, do I regret that.
: Nothing happened, Chika.
: And why should I believe you, huh? You’ve been getting nudes from other girls and never bothered telling me about them. You kissed Yumi and never told me about that.
: Hell, I don’t even know who this fucking person you lost that you’ve been crying about for months is because you’ve been keeping me in the dark about literally everything.
: I’m doing that because I l-
: You can’t just tell me you love me to get out of shit, okay?! Those aren’t magic words that make all the pain disappear!
: When you hurt, I hurt! I’ve been trying to tell you that this whole time! But you were too busy screwing my best friend to even give a shit! What kind of man are you?!
: The worst kind imaginable, pretty much.
: But why? Are you seriously just bored of me? I stopped being clingy like you asked.
: I know.

: I gave you so much space that it basically started killing me. I haven’t pressed you for sex. I even went out and got an apartment and changed my phone plan so you wouldn’t have to pay for me anymore.
: And did I mention how I haven’t pressed you for sex? Because I’ve been going crazy over here and think that deserves a little more fanfare. But the fact remains, I did everything you wanted!
: You did. You’re right.
: So why?! How could you do this to me?! To Chinami?! She practically thinks you’re her real father!
: Can I talk now? Or do you need to get more of this out of your system? Because I’m not sure how much you’ve saved up ever since the whole sadness coma thing.
: I had a fucking million things I wanted to say...but I can barely remember any of them now.
: I’m sad...and angry...and scared...and it’s all your fault. This is what happens when you leave me alone.
: I thought things would change once you started leaving the house again. I thought you’d go back to normal. But you’ve been more distant than ever and now I understand why.
: Chika...you don’t, though.
: It’s true that I was with Yumi and it’s true that it looked really bad, but nothing happened. And nothing happened when we went back to my room either because we’re not like that.
: There were a bunch of other girls in my room that night too. That was the whole reason I came to the beach in the first place.
: You fucked an entire room full of girls while I was bawling my eyes out in a public bathroom?
: Wha- no. That’s not what I meant. We were having a...meeting.
: You...were having a meeting?
: ...Yeah.
: How fucking gullible do you think I am, Sensei?
: I know how it sounds. But you could ask any of the girls who were there and they’ll tell you the same thing.
: Or...wait. Maybe not all of them. I’m not sure who remembers what, but...Yumi. Yumi remembers. Noriko and Sana probably don’t. Ayane and Makoto definitely remember too.
: You didn’t even think up a believable story on the way over, huh? So that’s how little I mean to you.
: Chika-
: Just break up with me now and get it over with. I have to figure out how I’m going to break the news to Chinami.
: That’s what you want, isn’t it?
: Even if I’m mad at Yumi...I can’t say she wouldn’t be good for you. In fact, that’s probably why this is so hard for me in the first place.
: All the signs were there. You’d never choose a girl like me if someone like her was an option. Someone who won’t ever press you about anything and just...lets you be you.
: I’m sorry that couldn’t be me. I tried. I really did. But if you’re still not comfortable with me after all this time, I’m not sure what else I can do.
: Chika, for the last time...nothing happened with Yumi.
: But you want something to happen with her...don’t you?
: Just the way you two were looking at each other back there was enough to do this to me. I guess I just...wanted to be the only girl you ever stared at like that.
: So even if “nothing” happened...even if that kiss was a stupid thing you guys did before we ever started hanging out...it feels like something happened. And I hate it. So fucking much.
: Like...yeah. It’s probably dumb, but I don’t think you really comprehend just how in love with you I am, Sensei. In my mind, we’re basically husband and wife already.
: If you want to be creeped out by that, feel free. Go...stare into the eyes of some other girl who’s probably wishing the same thing and then...forget us entirely.
: But next time...maybe don’t tell someone you love them unless you mean it...okay?
: Chika...I...
: Hah...
: I know you said these words alone can’t make the pain go away, but I do love you. It’s just...
: The thing is...love is kind of confusing.
: You can fucking say that again.
: I mean, like...I don’t think I see it the way other people do. It’s hard to describe. And sometimes I don’t think I see it at all.
: But when I look at you, I see someone I want to spend the rest of my life with.
: And I want to kiss you and fuck you and hold your hand and do all of those things, but...I’m not sure if I’ll ever be able to talk to you.
: You don’t have to talk, Sensei. You just have to be there. I already resigned myself to a life of never knowing what the fuck is going on in your head.
: Right. But can you resign yourself to a life where those feelings aren’t unique to you? Because that’s the next part I was getting to.
: So-
: I would get together with Yumi if she wanted to. Even though I know it would hurt you.
: The...unfortunate truth is that there are so many of you that I want to spend the rest of my life with. Physically and emotionally. Albeit with the emotional part kind of suppressed, but still.
: So...you want a life where you can kiss me...and fuck me...and hold my hand...but then turn around and do that same thing with everyone else?
: That’s right.
: And you don’t think that’s the most selfish, disgusting thing you could possibly say to a girl who would literally die for you?
: No, I do. I get that. Which is why I never brought it up.
: Do you think I want to feel like this? Do you have any idea how much easier all of this would be if I could just choose someone? Because I’d take that over whatever I am any day of the week.
: I live in a perpetual state of having to hide who I am from everyone because who I am sucks. And you’ve been more sheltered from that than anyone because of how deeply I care about you.
: I’m winning?
: What?
: If I’m the most sheltered...it means you...think about me the most...and...then...everyone else, you’re...more okay with hurting...so I’m...being prioritized and...
: That means if...you had to make a choice...it’d be me...it would definitely be me...because you’re okay with other girls...being in pain and...I’m the special one...
: I’m the special one...and if I’m special...it means that I am loved...and everyone else, you just...you think you love them...but it’s really me...
: I’m the one you love...
: I’m the one you love...
: Chika?...
: Huh?
: Are you...okay?
: Yeah. Why?
: You just...it seems like you’re having a...hard time processing what I’m trying to say to you.
: Oh, no. I think I get it now.
: I’m...not sure you do.
: No, yeah. You want to fuck other girls, right?
: But you also want to fuck me. Just more.
: Because you love me.
: And others.
: Right. But you love me.
: I “love” multiple people.
: But I’m winning.
: It’s not a competition, Chika...
: Yes it is. And I’m winning it.
: You’re not-
: Do you love Yumi?
: Well...no.
: But-
: Great!
: No, not great. I think we need to keep talking.
: No, no. It’s fine. I get it now!
: But I’m gonna do the same thing and go fuck a bunch of other guys too.
: Just kidding! Hahahah! You’re the only one who can get a piece of this because I’m your special girl! And like, where would I even find other guys anyway? Hahahaha!

: I bet their dicks are all small and stuff. Not like yours, [chikamaster]. You’ve got the best dick of all. And it fits inside me so perfectly! We’re practically made for each other, right?! Hahahaha!
: Chika-

: Hey, here’s an idea! Why don’t you fuck me over the railing right now? Then maybe we can fall and die and be on the news and everyone would call us the next Romeo and Juliet! Just hotter. God, I love you.
: So, just to clarify, we’re not breaking up. Right? Like, we’re still together. And that whole thing with you and Yumi was just a misunderstanding. But you would fuck her. Just, I’m the special one.
: And you love me and I love you and we all love each other but you also “love” other girls because they’d all feel bad if you didn’t. I’m so glad we had this talk!
Something went wrong.
I must have given her rabies.
: Chika-
: What?????
: I need you to calm down...and take a deep breath.
: Okay! Anything for you and your amazing, awesome dick that isn’t actually my property but is, like, totally my property! Hahahaha!
: Chika...breathe.
: Haaaaaaaaaah....
: Hooooooooooooh...
: Are you...feeling any better?
: Yes.
: Are you really sure you’re feeling better?
: I am really sure I’m feeling better.
: Okay. Because I just dropped a pretty big revelation on you and I don’t want this to be one of those things where you’re just pretending to feel better but actually aren’t.
: I’m feeling better, Sensei.
: I also don’t want it to be one of those things where you don’t actually understand what’s going on and just rewrite it all into the most ideal situation inside of your-
: I am feeling better, Sensei! There is no longer a need to worry about Chika Chosokabe! All is good here in the life I’ve always wanted.
: Right...
: Want to stick around for dinner? There was a sale on beef at the grocery store, so I was planning on making stew or something tonight.
: Just don’t tell Yumi about it if you do. I told her there was only enough for two when I was mad and wanted to kill her.
: I’m good. But you should probably try and get in contact with her soon since you now know she’s done literally nothing wrong and that I am the truly horrible one here.
: Nah, you’re just a little confused. But that’s something we can work on together!
: Chika...are you really okay?
: Mhm!
: And you really get what I was trying to tell you a couple minutes ago?
: Mhm!
: You know rabies is pretty much 100%% fatal if you don’t treat it immediately, right?
: What?
: Nothing. Forget I said anything.
: Wait! You forgot your kiss goodbye.
Chika pounces on me just as I turn to head back for the door, forcing my neck down by the collar of my shirt before planting a kiss on my lips.
: I love you!
: Say it back~
: I love you too...
: Heheheh...
: Come back soon, okay?
: I bought something super hot with my first paycheck from the maid cafe that I’ve been waiting to use with you.
: Uhh...okay. Yeah.
: Oh, and tell Chinami I’ll come back inside in a sec. Just gonna take a minute to collect my thoughts and...finish air-drying my face from the tears.
: Yeah...
: I’ll...see you later, Chika.
: Mhm! Laters!
: Hah...
: Well, this’ll definitely take some getting used to.
: But at least I wasn’t dumped!
: I just have a “different idea of what love is.”
: He’s so cool. That’s such a mature thing to say. Like, obviously he would know better than me.
: Yet, he’d still pick me over everyone else!
: Ah! I have to apologize to Yumi.
: The threesome is back on.
: I was super hard on her earlier.
: But then I get to tell Chinami that everything is going to be okay!
: That everything is going to be okay.
: That everything is going to be okay!
Chika has contracted [[RABIES]!
Her sanity has decreased by 10!
Her affection has increased by 1,000!
